fieldValues.title: A decision is asked for without what it takes to judge it
fieldValues.statement: A decision can only be taken when the person deciding has what they need to judge it: the question, the stakes, the real options including doing nothing, and what each leads to. Without that, or when the presentation leaves only one plausible answer, approving is not a decision. When AI prepares most of what reaches the owner, a polished presentation can stand in for a choice, and authority over the group's meaning passes to whoever framed the question.
